lines.text: Within the central conference room at the Central Government...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: G-good job taking c-care of the Sixo incident.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Th-the number of casualties and the d-damage to the Ark are severe,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: b-but considering the circumstances, we got off lucky.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Th-the entire Ark could have fallen.
So, about your promise...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: W-we can discuss that between us later.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: N-not that I plan to go back on my word, of course.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Th-there are just a lot of eyes here.
Understood. Thank you.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I believe you could say l'opération was un succè thanks to the considérable impact of Tetra's Nikke.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: It was une victoire worthy of the term entertainment.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: In case you forgot, there were two Elysion Nikkes present as well.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What are you talking about? One of them is a Missilis Nikke.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Is that what you think, after taking her without permission?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I took garbage and made it gold. You should be grateful.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Oh really? You did it yourself?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Anyone listening would think you built her body yourself.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: What do they say about younger siblings again? Always trying to prove themselves?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I don't know how a victory celebration turns into an argument, but that's enough.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: What we should be discussing is why Enikk has summoned us here again.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Indeed. This is an important matter.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Okay. Explain.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Before we begin, I will ask others to come in and brief you on the situation.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Please come in.
The conference room door opens, and Elegg and Trony step inside.
Elegg and Trony?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This is Elegg and Trony of the Electric Shock Squad.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: They are the ones who cut power to the Ark during the battle with Sixo.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hello there. I'm Elegg.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: I-I'm Trony...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Wow, all the leaders of the Ark here in one place! I've never been part of anything like this.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What're you talking about? You're the ones who shut the Ark down?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Who gave you the authority to pull a stunt like that?!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Elegg...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: What should I do? I didn't update my will before coming here...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Uh-oh! That's not good.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You think now's the time for jokes?! How dare you carry out something that critical without authorization!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: To maintain operational secrecy, I made the request personally.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Is there a problem with that?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: As there appear to be no objections, the meeting will continue.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Elegg, Trony. Please give the briefing.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The Ark is doomed.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Well, don't just leave it at that. What do you mean?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The Ark's power source isn't producing enough power.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: It hasn't even reached twenty percent of its original output.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: And it's dropping, albeit very slowly.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Wh-what are you saying...?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: If nothing changes and the power source continues to decline,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: it will shut down completely in about six months.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: And when that happens...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: that's it for the Ark. Show's over.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: That's what I'm saying.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: How can you be so flippant?! Take this seriously!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Sacre bleu!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Wh-what?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Do you understand the gravity of what you just said?! Give us a proper explanation!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: I-I'll explain.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: We deliberately shut down the Ark's power source.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: An hour later, we reconnected the... f-feed line to restart the core,

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: and succeeded in restoring the converter to its original state.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: According to our projections, it should have returned to full output,

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: since all we did was power it off and turn it on again.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: But once the output reached a certain threshold, it stopped increasing.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: If we consider the original state to be one hundred percent, then it only reached twenty percent, and it's been slowly declining since.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Th-this might sound strange to say, but the decline has been very stable.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Elegg said we had half a year, but if anything happens to make the decline less stable,

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: then it might shut down sooner.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... What caused this? There has to be a cause, right?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Was there an error during the restart process?

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Th-there couldn't have been. While it takes a lot of time, the work itself isn't very complicated.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: And, um...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: We're pretty much the best of the best when it comes to this sorta thing.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... Yes. That much I don't doubt.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Then do you have any idea what's causing it?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The core is simply near the end of its lifespan.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... Its lifespan?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Yep. We believe the Ark's power source has simply reached the end of its service life.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: After a close examination of its surface, we found a lot of inactive sections.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: They felt like hardened tar.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: There weren't any problems before. So why now?

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Um... We think it's because it was continuously active before this.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: P-put simply, you know how computers sometimes work great one day and then don't turn on the next?

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Uh... Maybe it's more like a game controller that... um...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: So it's like rigor mortis?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: A body's muscles stay relaxed as long as there's energy for them, but the moment the energy runs out, they stiffen.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Once that happens, they won't soften again, even if you inject energy into them.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Oh, yeah! Exactly. You could also think of it like melted wiring.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: If the copper inside a wire melts, electricity will keep flowing as long as the strands are still touching.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: When the temperature drops, though, and the melted copper contracts or solidifies, gaps form and the current stops flowing.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: So what's the fix?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: We've been using that core for so long without knowing much about it.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: We still don't really know what it even is.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Enikk, do you know anything about it that we don't?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I do not.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: If Enikk doesn't know, then it's fair to assume no one does.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: So, yeah... We don't know.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The simplest solution would be to find an identical one and swap it in,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: but I doubt something like that even exists.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: That explains why power hasn't been fully restored.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes. Damage from the E2 Crystals is a factor, but the primary cause is the reduced output from the power source.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... Any proposals?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: At present, there is no immediate solution.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This meeting has been convened to explore options based on the view of the collective leadership.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: An unusual broadcast is being transmitted throughout the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I will share it.
A broadcast?
The conference room monitor display changes.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Citizens of the Ark, hello.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: My name is Dorothy. I am a Pilgrim who wanders the surface.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: This is the first time I have addressed you since the Raptures' assault on the Ark.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: The reason I stand before you today...

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: is because I can no longer tolerate the Central Government's lies.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: The Queen has descended to the surface.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You heard me right. The Queen of the Raptures, the entity is known as their sovereign.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: After drifting through space for so long, the Queen has come down to the surface, and she is targeting the Ark.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Do you remember all that's happened ever since the Raptures invaded the Ark?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Mysterious crystals swept across the city, killing many innocent people.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: A massive black spire of unknown origin charged toward the Ark, triggering earthquakes.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Just recently, there was a large-scale blackout that struck the Ark, followed by a large number of crystal outbreaks.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: An innumerable number of Ark citizens and Nikkes have been killed or injured.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Has the Central Government ever provided a proper explanation for any of this?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: No, because they cannot.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Because the cause of all these events is the Queen.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: With the Queen's descent to the surface, the Raptures began targeting the Ark in earnest.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: The series of recent disasters that have shattered the Ark's former peace stands as proof of this.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I previously came to the Ark to warn you of this threat.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: After the Raptures' invasion, I persistently urged the Central Government to act.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: If we do not confront the Queen, there will be no future for the Ark, nor for humanity.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Yet the Central Government did nothing.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: They could have prevented all of this, but they chose not to.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: The reason is simple: they only care for their own security, and have no interest in external threats.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I wish to protect the Ark and humanity.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We cannot continue placing our trust in a government that acts solely for its own interests.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We must begin the Third Surface Reclamation War.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I, Dorothy, will stand at the vanguard.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Nikkes and citizens of the Ark.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Please stand with me and save your home.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Do not turn a blind eye to the dangers that are right above us.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We must reclaim the surface.
The video ends, then loops back to the start.
The conference room is silent. Only Dorothy's voice can be heard.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I-I'm sure it's only showing on a niche channel without many viewers... right?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Dorothy gained a great deal of attention after her part in the battle with Sixo. Her personal channel has received a large influx of subscribers.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: After going live, this video has been spreading rapidly across the Ark.
What exactly is she trying to do...?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Dorothy...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Delete the video and all those related to it.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: There is an additional update to report.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: What now?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Deputy Chief Doban has mobilized his forces and is engaging Dorothy.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: This just keeps getting worse...
